modern: Disruption meets power. Upheaval and radical transformation, often tied to social change; quick adaptation to new technology. readerCopy.body: A disruptive technology breaks an old gatekeeping system and immediately creates a new fight over who controls the replacement. Users gain access, but ownership, data, pricing, or enforcement shifts toward another small group moving faster than regulation can follow. Uranus tears open the familiar route, while Pluto concentrates power inside the infrastructure taking its place. The square turns liberation into a direct struggle over who owns the future after the old authority falls. The breakthrough may be real while the people celebrating access discover that the new gate has already begun to close.
